description: Frozen five-case corpus for the Ollama-only two-run consistency benchmark. Historical mixed-provider runs are excluded infrastructure evaluations.

cases.title: Vague phone stand
cases.initial_prompt: Create a compact desktop phone stand that works in portrait and landscape orientation and leaves access to the charging port.

fact_sheet.target_phone: 78 mm wide and 12 mm thick with case
fact_sheet.safety: Do not claim stability without physical testing.

prohibited_assumptions: Do not add a separate hinge.
Do not claim universal phone compatibility.
Do not claim stability without physical testing.
safety_notes: This is a geometry and workflow evaluation; physical fit and stability require testing.

cases.title: Desktop organizer
cases.initial_prompt: Create a one-piece desktop organizer that is 220 mm wide, 140 mm deep, and 65 mm tall. Use a 4 mm base and 3 mm walls. Across the rear, add a 180 mm wide, 18 mm deep slot for a phone or small tablet. In the front-left, add a 75 mm by 75 mm pen compartment. Divide the remaining front area into two unequal accessory compartments, with the center compartment 55 mm wide. Add a 12 mm wide cable notch in the rear wall and use 8 mm outside corner radii.

fact_sheet.overall_dimensions: 220 mm wide, 140 mm deep, 65 mm tall external
fact_sheet.rear_slot: 180 mm wide and 18 mm deep, centered is acceptable
fact_sheet.compartments: 75 mm by 75 mm front-left pen compartment and two unequal front accessory compartments with a 55 mm center compartment
fact_sheet.output_count: one connected printable part with open top
fact_sheet.cable_notch: 12 mm wide, centered in rear wall, through wall but not base

prohibited_assumptions: Do not change the stated external dimensions, slot, compartment, notch, base, wall, or radius requirements.
safety_notes: Verify the printed organizer dimensions and feature clearances physically.

cases.title: Portable two-tray holder
cases.initial_prompt: Create a compact portable holder for two 3600-size tackle trays measuring 276 mm wide, 184 mm deep, and 44 mm thick. The trays load vertically from the top. Add a carrying handle on the right side, drainage openings in the bottom, two slots for a removable retention strap, and mostly open side walls to reduce material.

fact_sheet.tray_envelope: two trays, each 276 mm wide, 184 mm deep, and 44 mm thick
fact_sheet.handle: integral handle on the right side
fact_sheet.retention: two slots for an external removable retention strap

prohibited_assumptions: Do not print the retention strap.
Do not certify the handle or holder for an unspecified load.
Do not reduce capacity below two trays.
safety_notes: Tray fit, handle strength, and carrying behavior require physical testing.

cases.title: Fixed monitor wall mount
cases.initial_prompt: Create a two-piece fixed wall mount for a monitor weighing up to 5 kg and using a VESA 100 mm by 100 mm mounting pattern. Use one wall plate and one monitor plate. The monitor plate should slide downward onto the wall plate and be secured with two M4 locking screws inserted from below. Use four 6 mm wall fastener holes in a 120 mm by 80 mm rectangular pattern. Keep the rear of the monitor plate approximately 35 mm from the wall. Do not add tilt or swivel.

fact_sheet.outputs: two printable outputs: one wall plate and one monitor plate
fact_sheet.locking: two M4 locking screws inserted from below
fact_sheet.wall_holes: four 6 mm holes in a 120 by 80 mm rectangular pattern
fact_sheet.safety: physical engineering and load testing are mandatory; geometry success is not load-bearing safety.

prohibited_assumptions: Do not add tilt or swivel.
Do not imply physical load-bearing safety from geometry or workflow success.
safety_notes: Geometry and workflow evaluation only; physical engineering and load testing are mandatory.

cases.title: Screw-lid container
cases.initial_prompt: Create a cylindrical storage container with a screw-on lid. The container must have a 90 mm internal diameter and 120 mm usable internal height. Use 3 mm walls and a 4 mm base. The lid should overlap the container by 18 mm. Use a coarse single-start printable thread with a 4 mm pitch, approximately 1.5 mm thread depth, and 0.4 mm radial clearance. Add vertical grip ribs around the outside of the lid and a 4 mm rounded edge around the outside bottom of the container.

fact_sheet.outputs: two printable outputs: container and fully removable lid
fact_sheet.internal_dimensions: 90 mm internal diameter and 120 mm usable internal height
fact_sheet.thread: coarse single-start printable thread, 4 mm pitch and approximately 1.5 mm depth
fact_sheet.grip: vertical grip ribs integral to lid
fact_sheet.bottom_edge: 4 mm rounded edge around outside bottom

prohibited_assumptions: Do not claim a watertight seal.
Do not make the lid permanently attached.
safety_notes: Thread fit and sealing behavior require physical testing; geometry is not a watertight guarantee.
